verdict.rationale: Deepgram Voice Agent is a cloud API/SaaS product; all evidence points to hosted WebSocket endpoints, EU regional endpoints, and cloud-based configuration — there is no mention of a self-hostable or on-premises deployment package for the core voice agent model/inference stack. missing for 10: any self-hosting/on-prem deployment option, downloadable model weights or container, docs on running the core service outside Deepgram's cloud.
